review: Independent read-only verification of the user-reported Freighter-funded CLI Mainnet run
verdict: PASS for the bounded funding, registration, allowance, three payments and exhausted-budget checks; not an external organization approval

artifacts.qualification: The supplied CLI output identifies the version and source. Separate public-registry verification records published package provenance; transaction receipts alone do not prove client executable identity.

exactOperations: Payer creates canonical Circle USDC trustline with limit 0.03
Merchant creates canonical Circle USDC trustline with limit 0.03
Owner pays payer exactly 0.03 canonical Circle USDC

checks: Exactly one official registry register_mandate invocation
Exact payer, agent, merchant, canonical USDC, budget 300000, expiry and credential hash
RPC return value equals the mandate ID below
Exactly one canonical USDC approve invocation
Spender is the official registry, never the agent

checksAppliedToEveryTransaction: Pinned RPC reports the Mainnet network passphrase
Requested hash equals the returned hash and the recomputed Mainnet envelope hash
additionalChecksAppliedToEveryPayment: Configured agent is the transaction source
Exactly one official registry execute_payment invocation with the exact mandate ID, amount 100000 and sequence 0/1/2
One unambiguous typed official registry payment event matches the mandate, merchant, canonical USDC and consumed sequence
One matching canonical Circle USDC transfer event moves 100000 stroops from the payer to the merchant
limitations: Verification uses trusted pinned public RPC and Horizon, not a cryptographic ledger-state attestation.
The user reports the Freighter interaction. Public chain data verifies the resulting funding and payment transactions, not which wallet application displayed or approved them.

HTTP resource labels, delivery completion and the actual fourth HTTP attempt rely on the supplied CLI output. Independent read-only simulation corroborates budget rejection; history confirms there was no fourth applied agent transaction at observation.

The result covers this bounded run, not every retry, outage, host-crash or adversarial scenario. Hosted crash recovery remains fail-closed and does not promise crash-safe exact receipt snapshots or exact delivery.

No private keys, seed phrases, capabilities, signed envelopes or reusable payment-proof signatures are included. Public transaction envelopes were decoded read-only; the verifier neither signed nor submitted a transaction.
